notes:
v0.6.26: pipx install lxmf + pipx inject rns lxmf in bootstrap script.

The script did only 'pipx inject rns lxmf' which puts lxmf in
the rns venv's site-packages but does NOT create the
/home/pi/.local/bin/lxmd shim (pipx inject is shim-less).

The lxmd.service systemd unit ExecStart is /home/pi/.local/bin/lxmd,
so without the shim the service can't start. The launcher's
component check does 'import LXMF' from the rns venv's python,
which works because lxmf is in the venv.

Fix: do BOTH:
  1. pipx install lxmf (creates standalone lxmd shim)
  2. pipx inject rns lxmf (puts lxmf in rns venv for launcher)

Same problem applies to any pipx-injected package whose
binaries the launcher's systemd units reference.
